title: REPORT on the implementation of the Recovery and Resilience Facility
part_text: 23. Notes that the ECA has cast doubt on how the implementation of RRF measures has contributed to the green transition and has recommended improvements to the methodologies used to estimate the impact of climate-related measures; highlights the fact that the same methodological deficiencies exist across all pillars of the RRF, which reinforces the general impression that the real and concrete results of the RRF are far more modest than the lofty ambitions publicly proclaimed;
